ui.common.actions.cancel.note: Abandon the pending edit/action without applying it; the caller owns whether a field, form or confirmation closes. Does not interrupt already-running work.

ui.common.actions.close.note: Dismisses a dialog, sheet or other closeable surface without quitting the application.

ui.common.actions.copied.note: Replaces the button's own label for a moment after a successful clipboard write, then reverts. A state, not an action the reader can press again: do not rephrase it as an imperative or as a second verb.
ui.common.actions.copied.length: One word; the button keeps its width while this shows.

ui.common.actions.copy_failed.tone: Plain statement plus the manual workaround; no apology, no blame.
ui.common.actions.copy_failed.note: Shown when the clipboard write is refused (browser permission policy, inactive document). The content is still on screen, so the second sentence names the recovery the reader has; never drop it and never promise a retry the component cannot make.

ui.common.actions.retry.note: Retry the same failed read or write; the attempted input is retained and no record is deleted.

ui.common.actions.retry_again.note: Attempts the failed action again; not navigation, sign-out or reload by definition.
